observation_schema: 7x7x3 original Farama MiniGrid-DoorKey-8x8-v0 image, direction, mission. Last image[3][6] is carried-object public encoding; image[3][5] is source-public front.

analyses.same_source: Verify the two independent parent-run 28MB original selected-action receipts separately, equal canonical content hashes and original source-origin accounting.
analyses.public_state_repetition: Within each independently reset episode, compute unique full public image+direction+mission strings and repeat observations; no hidden pose or world seed used by model.
analyses.nonprogress: Count original source transitions with exactly unchanged public before vs after and selected action code, without assuming no global motion from local view equivalence.
analyses.key_carry: Count observations whose public image[3][6] carries key (object ID=5); separately count key-carry with original action 2 (forward) and with any visible door (object ID=4), locked door immediately at public front (object=4,state=2).
analyses.causal_chain: Verify source-reported visible pickup and door-open event fields against public before/after. Count key-carry to front-door to door-open to original goal reward. Missing events are observed zeros, not substituted or invented.
analyses.controls: Report native and uniform-random original source steps and rates side by side per seed, no effect sizes claimed with N=3 and no claim that random is capacity-matched.
analyses.no_new_experiment: This audit only reads an already-expended development source, has no new prospective first-use, no heldout, no additional original env.step.

diagnostic_hypothesis.H1: Native-only uncertainty actions result in >0.85 repeated exact public observations in at least 2/3 original seeds for each native arm.
diagnostic_hypothesis.H2: Both native arms have zero original forward actions while visibly carrying a key.
diagnostic_hypothesis.H3: No native selected episode exhibits an original public front-locked-door while visibly carrying a key.
diagnostic_hypothesis.interpretation: These outcomes identify lack of multi-step public-effect memory and causal contact, not neural architecture inferiority, a new accepted science result, or proof that specific replacement mechanisms work.
diagnostic_hypothesis.next_intervention: Source-native episodic public state+selected consequence memory plus learned action-effect/novelty preference, independently implemented in Wingless Go and Yggdrasil local cells; compare to matched conventional episodic novelty control, identical source observations/FIT, separate cold checkpoints and resource budget. Do not handcode key->pickup, door->toggle, map coordinates, navigation objective or external rescue. Freeze before coding; unfamiliar-seed evaluation remains non-first-use until separately admitted.
